title: `TRY_CAST` takes text only
verdict: `TRY_CAST` of a string; `TRY_TO_*`; `DIV0`; no `TRY` for arithmetic
description: `TRY_CAST('abc' AS NUMBER)` is NULL, and so is a value that does not fit (`'1000'` to `NUMBER(3,0)`). `TRY_CAST` of a non-string is a compile error (`TRY_CAST(1.5::FLOAT AS NUMBER)`). `TRY_TO_NUMBER`, `TRY_TO_DOUBLE`, `TRY_TO_DATE`, `TRY_TO_BOOLEAN` give NULL on failure; `DIV0` and `DIV0NULL` give 0 for a zero divisor. Arithmetic has no non-raising form.
reference: `cast` with `failure_behavior: RETURN_NULL` gives NULL. sverify's SQL writes a failing cast of a double as a `CASE` (`float_to_int_or_null`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT try_cast(x AS NUMBER(38,0)) FROM (VALUES (1.5::FLOAT)) AS s(x)
evidence.observed: error 001065 (22023): SQL compilation error: Function TRY_CAST cannot be used with arguments of types FLOAT and NUMBER(38,0)

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
